Leave the worries of daily life behind as you emerge and make your way to a comfy poolside lounger to bask in the Turkish sun. Read a book, listen to music, or just switch off and enjoy time to yourself whilst looking out over the Aegean Sea. When you’re too hot, do it all over again. Jump, swim, lounge, repeat. Hillside Beach Club also organises various poolside activities, such as water polo, aqua fitness and other pool games, so there’s always something to keep you busy without leaving the poolside. BARUT HEMERA / Gallery GALLERY A Glimpse into the Barut World Discover the distinctive atmosphere of Barut through sunlit shores, refined architecture and thoughtfully designed experiences. Each image captures a sense of place, effortless hospitality and the memorable moments that shape every stay. All Accommodation Gastronomy Visit Page Experiences BARUT HEMERA BARUT HEMERA Side, Süleyman Demirel Blv. No:1, 07330 Manavgat/Antalya, Türkiye FAQ Does the hotel offer vegan options at breakfast? Yes, we offer a wide range of vegan and vegetarian options at our breakfast buffet, prepared with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Is Wi-Fi available at the hotel? Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the entire hotel, including all rooms, restaurants, and common areas. What facilities are available for children? We offer Kids & Youth Clubs, a children's pool, playground, and various supervised activities designed for different age groups. Is the hotel located on the beachfront? Yes, Barut Hemera is situated directly on the beachfront, offering private beach access and stunning sea views. Is airport transfer service available? Yes, we offer airport transfer services upon request. Please contact our reservations team to arrange your transfer in advance. For Reservations +90 444 96 00 [email protected] Nearby Places Side Museum 8 mins. Aspendos 32 mins. Manavgat Falls 15 mins. Perge 53 mins. A Mediterranean Destination Side wears its history lightly. An ancient theatre and the Temple of Apollo stand among its streets, the beaches run either side of the promontory, and the whole of the Pamphylian coast opens out from the hotel gate. When to Visit? How to Get There? What to Do?
